description: GET /day-changes/today (#7659, #7664, #7666, #7667, #7681, #7903) for care staff with a group and its own calendar (calendar:own): the caller's staff record, the day's absences and group handovers in one Workforce read, its teacher groups with the teachers of these and the covered groups in one School Membership read, the day's block changes, shifts, staff and group names, the school's and its Träger's closing days, the caller's calendar appointments of the day with their rules and the overrides of the dates that may reach today in one Appointments read, and the meal plan's change mark of the day, each in one batched read, inside a shared savepoint for consecutive read sources (SAVEPOINT and RELEASE count), plus the transaction frame. TestDayChangesQueryBudget compares one with four absences, substitutions, changed shifts and appointment exceptions (a cancelled date and a cancelled series).
